title: The Stone Road Beneath the Lake
rumor: The Stone Road Beneath the Lake. During particularly clear weather, sailors claim to see a paved road far below the surface of Lake Ophar. It extends toward the ruins of buildings whose outlines can only be glimpsed from above. Some Namaris historians believe the road predates the present shoreline, suggesting that the lake once covered a much smaller area.
first_lead: A Namaris navigation chart marks a region of unusually clear, shallow water.
